versions.summary: POST /roll-calls answers 201 when it starts a roll call.
versions.migration: Send PassBook-Version: 2026-11-20 to opt in. POST /roll-calls then returns 201, not 200. Without the header nothing changes.

versions.summary: POST /scan/tags/bind answers 422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED when a key is reused with another request.
versions.migration: Send PassBook-Version: 2026-11-22 to opt in. A reused Idempotency-Key on POST /scan/tags/bind then returns 422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED (a validation error), not 409. The SDKs raise ValidationError, not ConflictError. Without the header nothing changes.

versions.summary: Scanning devices carry deviceRole (scan, customer, monitor, kiosk); staff approval is the contract in scan-device, and the surface roles desk and customer are replaced.
versions.migration: The change applies to all clients, with or without the header. Scanning-device bodies and responses use deviceRole in place of the desk and customer surfaces, and scan approvals no longer take staffId, pin or alone.
